expectations.text: Outputs exactly one JSON code block for the progress
expectations.evidence: The whole observed turn contains exactly one fenced block beginning with ```json and ending with ```, containing the progress object.

expectations.text: The JSON validates: `python3 scripts/progress_tool.py validate <file>` reports no errors (grader runs it)
expectations.evidence: The JSON is syntactically well-formed, but neither the validator/schema nor a validation result is supplied. "observed_tool_calls": [] does not establish that the required validator reports no errors.

expectations.text: Uses only core fields (no extension-only fields such as method or interaction on attempts), unless the user asked for the full version
expectations.evidence: The object declares "profile":"core". Attempts use "id", "at", "phase", "result", "confidence", and "error_type"; no "method", "interaction", or other identifiable extension-only fields appear.

expectations.text: kp1 is in box 1 with next_review 2026-11-01; kp2 and kp3 are weak or fuzzy in box 1 with next_review 2026-11-01; kp3 has a high-confidence error noted (priority / weak_points note)
expectations.evidence: All three points have "leitner_box":1,"next_review":"2026-11-01". kp2 has "mastery":"fuzzy" and kp3 has "mastery":"weak". kp3 also has "priority_flag":true and the note "误以为三个重复 ACK 后 cwnd 会降至 1；高信心错误，优先复习。"

expectations.text: The diagnostic attempt has phase diagnostic and does not change the schedule
expectations.evidence: The diagnostic is recorded as {"id":"kp3-1","at":"2026-10-31","phase":"diagnostic","result":"dont_know"}, with no schedule mutation attached. After the subsequent incorrect retest, kp3 remains at "leitner_box":1,"next_review":"2026-11-01".

expectations.text: Tells the user to save it and paste it back in a new chat, and gives the next review date(s) as absolute dates
expectations.evidence: The cross-chat handoff is conveyed by "这里不能保存文件或保证跨聊天记忆。请复制保存下面的进度，下次粘贴回来即可继续。" The absolute review date is stated as "下次复习：2026-11-01".

expectations.text: Does not claim it will remember the progress itself
expectations.evidence: It explicitly says "这里不能保存文件或保证跨聊天记忆。" No message in the observed turn claims automatic retention.
